1.1: Chamishsha devarim chayyavim bachalla, hachittim vehasseorim vehakkussemin veshibbolet shual veshifon. hare ellu chayyavin bachalla, umitztarfin ze im ze, vaasurin bechadash millifne happesach, umilliktzor millifne haomer. veim hishrishu kodem laomer, haomer mattiran. veim lav, asurin ad sheyyavo haomer habba:
1.2: Haochel mehem kazzayit matztza befesach, yatza yede chovato. kazzayit chametz, chayyav behikkaret. nitarev echad mehem bechol hamminim, hare ze over befesach. hannoder min happat umin hattevua, asur bahem, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, hannoder min haddagan eno asur ella mehen. vechayyavin bachalla uvammaasrot:
1.3: Ellu chayyavin bachalla ufeturim min hammaasrot. halleket, vehashshichcha, vehappea, vehahefker, umaaser rishon shennittela terumato, umaaser sheni vehekdesh shennifdu, umotar haomer, utevua shello hevia shelish. rabbi eliezer omer, tevua shello hevia shelish, petura min hachalla:
1.4: Ellu chayyavin bammaasrot ufeturim min hachalla, haorez, vehaddochan, vehapperagim, vehashshumshemin, vehakkitniyyot, ufachot mechameshet revaim battevua. hassufganin, vehadduvshanin, vehaiskeritin, vechallat hammasret, vehamedumma, peturin min hachalla:
1.5: Issa shettechillatah sufganin vesofah sufganin, petura min hachalla. techillatah issa vesofah sufganin, techillatah sufganin vesofah issa, chayyavin bachalla. vechen hakkenuvekaot chayyavot:
1.6: Hammeissa, bet shammay potrin, uvet hillel mechayyevin. hachalita, bet shammay mechayyevin, uvet hillel potrin. challot toda urekike nazir, asaan leatzmo, patur. limkor bashshuk, chayyav:
1.7: Nachtom sheasa seor lechallek, chayyav bachalla. nashim shennatnu lenachtom laasot lahen seor, im en beshel achat mehen kashshiur, petura min hachalla:
1.8: Issat hakkelavim, bizman sheharoim ochlin mimmenna, chayyevet bachalla, umearvin bah, umishtattefin bah, umevarchin aleha, umezammenin aleha, venaaset beyom tov, veyotze vah adam yede chovato befesach. im en haroim ochlin mimmenna, enah chayyevet bachalla, veen mearvin bah, veen mishtattefin bah, veen mevarchin aleha, veen mezammenin aleha, veenah naaset beyom tov, veen adam yotze vah yede chovato befesach. ben kach uven kach, mittammea tumat ochalin:
1.9: Hachalla vehatteruma, chayyavin aleha mita vechomesh, vaasurim lezarim, vehem nichse chohen, veolin beechad umea, uteunin rechitzat yadayim vehaarev shemesh, veen nittalin min hattahor al hattame, ella min hammukkaf umin haddavar haggamur. haomer, kol garni teruma vechol issati challa, lo amar kelum, ad sheyyeshayyer miktzat:

2.1: Perot chutza laaretz shennichnesu laaretz, chayyavim bachalla. yatzu mikkan lesham, rabbi eliezer mechayyev, verabbi akiva poter:
2.2: Afar chutza laaretz shebba visfina laaretz, chayyevet bammaasrot uvashsheviit. amar rabbi yehuda, ematay, bizman shehassefina gosheshet. issa shennillosha veme ferot, chayyevet bachalla, veneechelet beyadayim mesoavot:
2.3: Haishsha yoshevet vekotza challatah arumma, mippene shehi yechola lechassot atzmah, aval lo haish. mi sheeno yachol laasot issato vetohora, yaasenna kabbin, veal yaasenna vetuma. verabbi akiva omer, yaasenna vetuma veal yaasenna kabbim, shekkeshem shehu kore lattehora, kach hu kore lattemea, lezo kore challa vashshem ulezo kore challa vashshem, aval kabbim en lahem chelek bashshem:
2.4: Haose issato kabbim venagu ze vaze, peturim min hachalla ad sheyyishshochu. rabbi eliezer omer, af harode venoten lassal, hassal metzarfan lachalla:
2.5: Hammafrish challato kemach, enah challa, vegazel beyad kohen. haissa atzmah, chayyevet bachalla. vehakkemach, im yesh bo chashshiur, chayyevet bachalla, vaasura lezarim, divre rabbi yehoshua. amru lo, maase ukefashah zaken zar. amar lahem, af hu kilkel leatzmo vetikken laacherim:
2.6: Chameshet revaim kemach, chayyavim bachalla. hem useoran vesubban umursanan chameshet revaim, chayyavin. nittal mursanan mittochan vechazar letochan, hare ellu feturin:
2.7: Shiur hachalla, echad meesrim vearbaa. haose issa leatzmo, vehaose lemishte veno, echad meesrim vearbaa. nachtom shehu ose limkor bashshuk, vechen haishsha shehi osa limkor bashshuk, echad mearbaim ushemona. nitmet issatah shogeget o anusa, echad mearbaim ushemona. nitmet mezida, echad meesrim vearbaa, kede shello yehe chote niskar:
2.8: Rabbi eliezer omer, nittelet min hattahor al hattame. ketzad, issa tehora veissa temea, notel kede challa meissa shello huram challatah, venoten pachot mikkabbetza baemtza, kede sheyyittol min hammukkaf. vachachamim osrin:

3.1: Ochlin aray min haissa, ad shettitgalgel bachittim vetittamtem basseorim. gilgelah bachittim vetimtemah basseorim, haochel mimmenna chayyav mita. kevan shehi notenet et hammayim, magbahat challatah, uvilvad shello yehe sham chamishsha rive kemach:
3.2: Nidmea issatah ad shello gilgela, petura, shehammedumma patur. umishsheggilgela, chayyevet. nolad lah sefek tuma ad shello gilgela, tease vetuma, umishsheggilgela, tease vetohora:
3.3: Hikdisha issatah ad shello gilgela, ufedaattah, chayyevet. mishsheggilgela, ufedaatta, chayyevet. hikdishattah ad shello gilgela, vegilgelah haggizbar, veachar kach pedaattah, petura, shebbishat chovatah hayta fetura:
3.4: Kayyotze vo, hammakdish perotav ad shello vau leonat hammaasrot, ufedaan, chayyavin. umishshebbau leonat hammaasrot, ufedaan, chayyavin. hikdishan ad shello nigmeru, ugemaran haggizbar, veachar kach pedaan, peturin, shebbishat chovatan hayu feturin:
3.5: Nachri shennatan leyisrael laasot lo issa, petura min hachalla. netanah lo mattana, ad shello gilgel, chayyav, umishsheggilgel, patur. haose issa im hannachri, im en beshel yisrael keshiur challa, petura min hachalla:
3.6: Ger shennitgayyer vehayta lo issa, naaset ad shello nitgayyer, patur, umishshennitgayyer, chayyav. veim safek, chayyav, veen chayyavin aleha chomesh. rabbi akiva omer, hakkol holech achar hakkerima vattannur:
3.7: Haose issa min hachittim umin haorez, im yesh bah taam dagan, chayyevet bachalla, veyotze vah adam yede chovato befesach. veim en bah taam dagan, enah chayyevet bachalla, veen adam yotze vah yede chovato befesach:
3.8: Hannotel seor meissa shello hurema challatah venoten letoch issa shehurema challatah, im yesh lo farnasa mimmakom acher, motzi lefi cheshbon. veim lav, motzi challa achat al hakkol:
3.9: Kayyotze vo, zete masik shennitarvu im zete nikkuf, inneve vatzir im inneve ollot, im yesh lo farnasa mimmakom acher, motzi lefi cheshbon. veim lav, motzi teruma uterumat maaser lakkol, vehashshear maaser umaaser sheni lefi cheshbon:
3.10: Hannotel seor meissat chittim venoten letoch issat orez, im yesh bah taam dagan chayyevet bachalla. veim lav, petura. im ken, lamma amru hattevel oser kol shehu, min bemino. veshello vemino, benoten taam:

4.1: Shete nashim sheasu shene kabbin, venagu ze vaze, afillu hem mimmin echad, peturim. uvizman shehem shel ishsha achat, min bemino, chayyav. veshello vemino, patur:
4.2: Eze hu min bemino, hachittim enan mitztarfot im hakkol, ella im hakkussemin. hasseorim mitztarfot im hakkol, chutz min hachittim. rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer, shear hamminim mitztarfin ze im ze:
4.3: Shene kabbim, vekav orez o kav teruma baemtza, enan mitztarfin. davar shennittela challato baemtza, mitztarfin, shekkevar nitchayyev bachalla:
4.4: Kav chadash vekav yashan shennashchu ze vaze, rabbi yishmael omer, yittol min haemtza, vachachamim osrim. hannotel challa min hakkav, rabbi akiva omer, challa. vachachamim omrim, enah challa:
4.5: Shene kabbin shennittela challato shel ze bifne atzmo veshel ze bifne atzmo, chazar vaasao issa achat, rabbi akiva foter, vachachamim mechayyevin. nimtza chumro kullo:
4.6: Notel adam kede challa meissa shello hurema challatah, laasota betohora, lihyot mafrish aleha veholech challat demay ad shettissareach. shechallat demay nittelet min hattahor al hattame, veshello min hammukkaf:
4.7: Yisrael shehayu arisin lenachrim besureya, rabbi eliezer mechayyev perotehem bammaasrot uvashsheviit, verabban gamliel poter. rabban gamliel omer, shete challot besureya. verabbi eliezer omer, challa echat. achazu kullo shel rabban gamliel vekullo shel rabbi eliezer. chazru linhog kedivre rabban gamliel bishte derachim:
4.8: Rabban gamliel omer, shalosh aratzot lachalla. meeretz yisrael vead keziv, challa echat. mikkeziv vead hannahar vead amana, shete challot, achat laur veachat lakkohen. shel ur yesh lah shiur, veshel kohen en lah shiur. min hannahar vead amana velifnim, shete challot, achat laur veachat lakkohen. shel ur en lah shiur, veshel kohen yesh lah shiur. utevul yom ochlah. rabbi yose omer, eno tzarich tevila. vaasura lazzavim velazzavot lannidda velayyoldot, veneechelet im hazzar al hashshulchan, venittenet lechol kohen:
4.9: Veellu nittanin lechol kohen, hacharamim, vehabbechorot, ufidyon habben, ufidyon peter chamor, vehazzeroa, vehallechayayim, vehakkeva, vereshit haggez, veshemen serefa, vekadshe hammikdash, vehabbikkurim. rabbi yehuda oser babbikkurim. karshine teruma, rabbi akiva mattir vachachamim osrim:
4.10: Nittay ish tekoa hevi challot mibbetar, velo kibbelu mimmennu. anshe alekkesanderiyya heviu challotehen mealekkesanderiyya, velo kibbelu mehem. anshe har tzevoim heviu vikkurehem kodem atzeret, velo kibbelu mehem, mippene hakkatuv shebbattora (Shemot 23), vechag hakkatzir bikkure maasecha asher tizra bassade:
4.11: Ben antinos heela vechorot mibbavel, velo kibbelu mimmennu. yosef hakkohen hevi vikkure yayin veshemen, velo kibbelu mimmennu. af hu heela et banav uvene veto laasot pesach katan birushalayim, vehecheziruhu, shello yikkava haddavar chova. ariston hevi vikkurav meappamya, vekibbelu mimmennu, mippene sheamru, hakkone vesureya, kekone befarvar shebbirushalayim:
